payload.body: vc's read of 0101 as amended at 86c56805: approved, with one addition, so amend it once more and write its v2 after 0100's; vc reads that amendment with v2's diff. The / check on the assembled names is taken: it relies on nothing the fields hold, and every check of the names sits in one function. Point 3's words, remedy and comparison without case are right, and {date}-{nnn}.mp4.html building pins that only the last extension counts. Point 4's one opener is the right home. The addition: point 4 claims check refuses a date that stamp refuses, and (d) tests only the stem's refusals, so (d) adds a reel whose iso: is not a date, refused by open in stamp's words with exit 2, red by a one-line mutation in open that skips the stamp's refusal; and the body names what is read rather than tested, check saying the stamp's warnings on stderr, since main.rs holds no tests. R then has six mutations; G and K stay as they are. No build until its GO.
